# Draft:Almohad-Ayyubid War

The Almohad-Ayyubid war was a conflict that started shortly after Saladins came into power in Egypt after overthrowing the Shia Fatimid Caliphate.The Reason for the conflict was because Saladin embarked on a campaign to conquer Libya either in 1171,1172 or 1173. The Almohads viewed the Ayyubid territorial expansion in the Maghreb as a threat to their territorial borders with the Ayyubid.
